name: Ambar Sen Antardhan Rahasya
body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind from 2.22.1 to 2.22.2 in /examples/java-example/maven-example in the maven group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/281
* feat: record resolved licenses for offline scans, fix pnpm and SBOM output by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/280
* feat(purl): add arch, distro, upstream and epoch qualifiers to OS package PURLs by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/282
* fix(filesystem): read the license from GNU grant sentences in pre-DEP-5 copyright files by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/283
* build(deps): bump com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind from 2.22.2 to 2.22.3 in /examples/java-example/maven-example in the maven group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/284
* feat(sbom): choose spec versions and write licenses the specs accept by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/285
* feat(sbom): read and write SPDX 3.0, SPDX tag:value and CycloneDX XML by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/286
* fix(licenses): recognise BSD-2/BSD-3 texts that never say BSD by @abhinyaay in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/277
* docs: add the Open Source India 2026 talk to Field Reports by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/287
* fix: correct lookups found by benchmarking and add a Performance page by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/288
* build(deps): bump webpki crates to drop compromised emudhra roots by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/290
* fix(java): remove maven search api license fallback (#296) by @slopgobblercobbler in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/301
* feat: cache OSI license data by @WilliamK112 in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/300
* build(deps): bump rustls from 0.23.40 to 0.23.46 in /examples/rust-example in the cargo group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/304
* feat(filesystem): read the rpm Berkeley DB backend by @paoValle in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/289
* fix(licenses): restore OSI status and keep the real cache age on retry by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/305
* test(filesystem): restore Berkeley DB fixture coverage by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/306
* fix(go): stop reading go.mod from the working directory for licenses by @maliv2 in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/302
* fix(node): attribute pnpm workspace dependencies to their members by @anistark in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/299

## New Contributors
* @abhinyaay made their first contribution in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/277
* @slopgobblercobbler made their first contribution in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/301
* @WilliamK112 made their first contribution in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/300
* @paoValle made their first contribution in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/289
* @maliv2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/anistark/feluda/pull/302

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anistark/feluda/compare/v1.17.0...v1.18.0
